english.title: Driver in Blackwall / Silvertown Tunnel areas prevent authorised person inspecting motor vehicle re dangerous goods
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being the driver of a motor vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY MOTOR VEHICLE..) in the

(A)_[Blackwall]_
(B)_[Silvertown]_

tunnel area, prevented an authorised person, namely **(..SPECIFY PERSON..) from inspecting the motor vehicle for the purpose of ascertaining its compliance with requirements which applied in respect of the carriage of dangerous goods
english.legislation: Contrary to byelaw 8(6) of the Blackwall and Silvertown Tunnels Byelaws 2018 and article 48(6) of the Silvertown Tunnel Order 2018.
